purpose: Definitions the router, query parser and narrator need to read user questions and the scheme_tags / department columns correctly. Terms are matched case-insensitively.

scheme_tags._note: Values found in the 'Scheme' column (scheme_tags in views.sql). Patterns come from SCHEMES_IDENTIFIER_BASE in TENDERS/scripts/mch_tenders.py. 'kind' says whether the tag is a programme or a department marker.

UIP.name: Universal Immunization Programme
UIP.covers: Vaccines, cold chain (ILR, deep freezers, vaccine carriers, cold boxes), immunisation infrastructure

ASHA.name: Accredited Social Health Activist programme
ASHA.covers: ASHA worker training, incentives, modules, reporting tools

JSY.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
JSY.covers: Institutional delivery cash incentives, referral transport for pregnant women

JSSK.name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram
JSSK.covers: Free delivery and C-section, free drugs, diagnostics, diet and transport for mother and newborn; Samahar kits

LAQSHYA.name: Labour room Quality Improvement Initiative (LaQshya)
LAQSHYA.covers: Labour room and maternity OT upgrades and certification
LAQSHYA.quirk: Also matched by generic phrases such as 'labour room strengthening', so many labour-room construction tenders carry this tag.

PMMVY.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
PMMVY.covers: Maternity benefit cash transfer for the first child

RBSK.name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram
RBSK.covers: Child health screening (0-18 years), District Early Intervention Centres (DEIC)

POSHAN_ABHIYAAN.name: POSHAN Abhiyaan
POSHAN_ABHIYAAN.covers: Nutrition monitoring, growth monitoring devices, anganwadi ICT

SUMAN.name: Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan (SUMAN)
SUMAN.covers: Respectful, zero-expense maternity and newborn care

RCH.name: Reproductive and Child Health programme
RCH.covers: Broad maternal and child service strengthening

NHM.name: National Health Mission (incl. NRHM)
NHM.covers: Health system strengthening, CHC/PHC upgrades, MCH wings
NHM.quirk: Also set when the procuring department is NHM, so it partly duplicates department_top.

MSDP.name: Multi-sectoral Development Programme
MSDP.covers: Infrastructure in minority concentration areas (e.g. labour rooms in Kokrajhar blocks)

SOPD.name: State Owned Priority Development
SOPD.covers: State-funded priority infrastructure (e.g. GMCH Mother and Child Hospital under SOPD-ODS)

MAMATA_KIT.name: Mamata kit distribution (Assam)
MAMATA_KIT.covers: Mother and newborn kits after delivery

SNEHA_SPARSHA.name: Sneha Sparsha (Assam)
SNEHA_SPARSHA.covers: Financial aid for specialty treatment of children

CHD_SCHEME.name: Congenital Heart Disease scheme (Assam)
CHD_SCHEME.quirk: False positive in this dataset: the pattern 'CHD' matches the BTC office 'Director Cum CHD - PWD BTC'. All 6 tenders tagged CHD_SCHEME are BTC civil works, not heart surgery. Exclude or flag CHD_SCHEME in scheme answers.

MAJONI.name: Majoni scheme (Assam)
MAJONI.covers: Financial security for the girl child

ASSAM_FREE_DIAGNOSTICS.name: Assam Free Diagnostics and Drugs scheme
ASSAM_FREE_DIAGNOSTICS.covers: Free tests and medicines for MCH

HFW.name: Health and Family Welfare Department
HFW.covers: Marks tenders issued by H&FW; not a scheme

PWD_NH.name: Public Works Department (Building and NH)
PWD_NH.covers: Marks PWD building tenders; not a scheme

departments._note: department_top values in views.sql (first segment of the '||' chain).
departments.National Health Mission: NHM Assam, State and District Programme Management Units. Largest issuer of MCH tenders, mostly goods and programme items.
departments.Public Works Building and NH Department: PWB&NH. Builds MCH wings, maternity wards and hospitals; largest by awarded value.
departments.Health and Family Welfare Department: H&FW, incl. medical colleges (GMCH, FAAMCH Barpeta, Nagaon MCH) and Assam Medical Services Corporation (AMSCL), which buys drugs and equipment.
departments.Bodoland Territorial Council: BTC, the autonomous council for Kokrajhar, Chirang, Baksa, Udalguri and Tamulpur. Procures separately. Also appears as 'Bodoland Territorial Council-PWD' (same body, different spelling).
departments.Bodoland Territorial Council-PWD: Same body as 'Bodoland Territorial Council'. Group the two together when comparing departments.
departments.Cooperation Department: One tender (West Assam Milk Producers Cooperative Union); a weak MCH match, treat with care.

procurement_terms.AOC: Award of Contract. 'Accepted-AOC' = this bid won; 'Rejected-AOC' = contract stage reached but the listed bid was not accepted.
procurement_terms.is_awarded: True when Status is one of Accepted-AOC / ACCEPTED / AWARDED / Work Awarded / AOC. Defined in VALID_AWARDED_STATUSES in mch_tenders.py.
procurement_terms.Not Admitted-Fee/PreQual/Technical: The listed bid failed fee, pre-qualification or technical checks.
procurement_terms.Rejected-Finance: The listed bid failed at financial evaluation.
procurement_terms.Rejected-Technical: The listed bid failed at technical evaluation.
procurement_terms.Awarded Value: Value of the bid listed in that row (bid_value_inr). Counts as spending only when is_awarded (awarded_amount_inr). For many goods and rate contracts it is ₹0, ₹1 or a per-unit rate (awarded_value_suspect).
procurement_terms.Works / Goods / Services: Tender Category: construction, supply, or services.
procurement_terms.OCDS: Open Contracting Data Standard, which the use case page says the tender data was mapped to.

units.currency: All money columns are in Indian rupees (₹, INR).
units.indian_digit_grouping: Raw 'Tender Value in ₹' uses 2-digit grouping after the first thousand (2,06,34,54,000 = ₹206.35 crore). Strip commas before casting.
units.fiscal_year: Indian fiscal year runs 1 April to 31 March; '2023-24' = Apr 2023 to Mar 2024. contract_fiscal_year in views.sql.

district_variants.Karimganj / Sribhumi: KARIMGANJ (renamed Sribhumi in Nov 2024; data uses KARIMGANJ)

geography.boundary_changes: Bajali and Tamulpur were carved out of Barpeta and Baksa in 2021-22 and are in the 2024-11 boundaries. Older tenders for those areas may be tagged to the parent district.
geography.btr: Bodoland Territorial Region districts: Kokrajhar, Chirang, Baksa, Udalguri, Tamulpur. is_btc marks tenders issued by BTC bodies.

mch_vocabulary._note: User words to map to this use case. Full keyword lists are in TENDERS/data/Keyword list.md and mch_tenders.py.
mch_vocabulary.IMR: Infant Mortality Rate (deaths under age 1 per 1,000 live births). Not in this dataset; see the IMR District-wise Assam dataset on DataSpace.
mch_vocabulary.MCH wing: Dedicated maternal and child health block at a hospital; the largest construction tenders
mch_vocabulary.GMCH: Gauhati Medical College and Hospital, Guwahati (Kamrup Metro)
mch_vocabulary.BPHC / CHC / PHC / SD: Block PHC / Community Health Centre / Primary Health Centre / State Dispensary
